description: How each corpus fills a unit's jurisdiction, owner and authority tier (Phase 4 spec §5.1). jurisdiction null takes the Phase 2 envelope's value; owner issuer takes the Phase 2 issuer, source_system the bench document's Source line; authority_tier maps the tier_by key of a document (URI family, bench source system or file format) to a tier of the unit scale (1 regulations and the IRM, 2 bench Confluence and Drive, 3 the repository's reports and notes, 4 PDFs, chat, mail and tickets). A document whose key is not listed takes phase2_tier[its Phase 2 tier], an explicit mapping from the Phase 2 scale (1 codified, 2 final and temporary rules, 3 notices and guidance, 4 proposed rules): Federal Register rules are regulations (1), notices are official but not regulations (2), proposed rules are not in force (4). No entry gives no tier.
